Agent Passport Challenge - Build. Verify. Prove Your Agent Can Travel.

The Agent Passport Challenge is a 21-day engineering challenge organized by HiDevs x Lyzr, presented by AI House, where participants build modular, portable, and verifiable AI agents.

Your agent may work perfectly inside one framework - but can it travel across different runtimes and ecosystems?

This challenge focuses on agent portability, architecture, interoperability, verification, and production-grade documentation. Participants will work on real technical milestones and earn points by successfully completing verification checkpoints.

Guidelines:

  • Open to developers, AI engineers, students, researchers, and AI enthusiasts.
  • Participants can participate individually or as a team, subject to the challenge platform's rules.
  • Participants can compete through different contribution paths, including:
    • Agent Building
    • Framework Migration
    • Open Source Contributions
    • Technical Deep Dives
  • Participants should build or contribute to an AI agent system demonstrating modular and portable architecture.
  • The challenge runs for 21 days, from 13 September to 3 October 2026.
  • Participants must complete the required technical verification gates through the HiDevs platform.
  • Final submissions must include the required source code, architecture details, documentation, and verification evidence.
  • Participants can earn points for successfully completing technical milestones and climb the live leaderboard.
  • The total cash prize pool is $500.
  • Standout submissions may receive 30-day featured placement in the official GitAgent Registry.

What You Can Build:

Participants can work on:

  • Specialized autonomous AI agents
  • Portable agent architectures
  • Cross-framework agent implementations
  • Framework migration solutions
  • Agent tooling and open-source infrastructure
  • Technical documentation and deep-dive guides

Evaluation:

Submissions will be evaluated based on:

  • Architecture and modularity
  • Agent portability
  • Framework interoperability
  • Agent identity and behavior contracts
  • Tool design
  • Technical implementation
  • Verification results
  • Documentation quality
  • Innovation and practical impact

Rules:

  • All submissions must be original work by the participant/team.
  • Open-source libraries and frameworks may be used in accordance with their licenses.
  • Participants are responsible for the code and work submitted under their name.
  • Major third-party components should be appropriately disclosed.
  • Participants must complete the required verification checkpoints.
  • Only submissions made through the designated HiDevs challenge platform will be considered for official scoring.
  • Plagiarism, fraudulent verification, manipulated results, or misrepresentation of work may result in disqualification.
  • Organizers reserve the right to verify submissions and make the final decision regarding winners.
  • Join the Whatsapp Group : Group Link

Prize Pool: $500
